note: Expands Markdown into ordinary editable Word paragraphs, runs and tables; add returns the first emitted block path. Implemented blocks: ATX headings, blank-line paragraphs, unordered and ordered list items, blockquotes, thematic breaks, fenced code blocks and GFM pipe tables. Inline **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~ and `code` become independently editable runs. The generated nodes can be addressed with normal /body/p[N] and /body/tbl[N] paths. Links/images and nested inline forms remain pending.

markdown.description: Markdown source text. Aliases: text, md. Use literal newlines between blocks.

src.description: Path to a UTF-8 Markdown source file. Alias: path.
